```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(scico)
source("2_Model/Code/Run_SDP.R")
```

## Set parameters

```{r SetParameters}
# Species name
species_name <- "Swift Parrot"

# Fecundity in wild and in captivity
fecundity_w <- 1.85
fecundity_c <- 2.3

# Month of breeding
breeding_month <- 10

# Starting/current month
start_month <- 10

# Monthly mortality in wild without H5N1, with H5N1, and in captivity
mortality_w_base <- 0.0338
mortality_w_flu <- 0.4
mortality_c <- 0.0058

# Translocation success rates (wild to captive, captive to wild)
phi_wc <- 0.9
phi_cw <- 0.75

# Cost of 100 indiviuals in captivity for 1 month
captive_cost <- 128889/2
# Cost of bringing in/releasing 100 individuals
cw_translocate_cost <- 1700000/2
wc_translocate_cost <- 1700000/2
# Cost of setting up captive pop if none exists
establish_cost <- 12500000

# Weighting of cost vs population
cost_weight <- 0.3

# Disease transition matrix: Rows are exposure at t, columns at t+1
disease_transitions <- matrix(
  #   1       2       3       4       5       6
  c(0.9800, 0.0196, 0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0001,  # 1
    0.0000, 0.8000, 0.1518, 0.0480, 0.0001, 0.0001,  # 2 
    0.0000, 0.0000, 0.6000, 0.3000, 0.0900, 0.0100,  # 3
    0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.5000, 0.3000, 0.2000,  # 4
    0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.2000, 0.8000,  # 5
    0.8000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.4000), # 6
  nrow = 6, 
  ncol = 6, 
  byrow = TRUE)

# Preview transition matrix
disease_transitions |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(t = as.character(1:6)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = paste0("V",1:6), 
               names_to = "tp1", 
               values_to = "prob") |>
  mutate(tp1 = str_remove(tp1, "V")) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = t, x = tp1, fill = prob, label = prob)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(colour = "white") +
  labs(y = "t", x = "t+1") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
```

## Run SDP

```{r RunSDP}
sdp_output <- run_SDP(fecundity_w = fecundity_w,
                      fecundity_c = fecundity_c, 
                      breeding_month = breeding_month, 
                      mortality_w_base = mortality_w_base,
                      mortality_w_flu = mortality_w_flu,
                      mortality_c = mortality_c, 
                      phi_wc = phi_wc,
                      phi_cw = phi_cw, 
                      disease_transitions = disease_transitions,
                      discount = 0.999,
                      Tmax = 36, 
                      start_month = start_month,
                      captive_cost = captive_cost, 
                      establish_cost = establish_cost, 
                      cw_translocate_cost = cw_translocate_cost,
                      wc_translocate_cost = wc_translocate_cost,
                      cost_weight = cost_weight)
```

## Save outputs

```{r SaveOutputs}
write_rds(sdp_output,
          paste0("2_Model/Outputs/Species/", species_name, ".rds"))
```
